sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. Its first recommendation CUA-Universe was already live in current origin/data, so main agent pivoted within the same table to Repeat-After-Me.

The article treats prompt-injection content as defensive research, avoids reproducing operational attack strings, and records query-cost, role-placement, synthetic-data, and defense-adaptation limits.
Reference search found no independent third-party replication; article uses arXiv HTML/source as primary evidence and frames prior visual-injection work through the paper's comparison table.
